flowchart TD

  node_roman["Roman source"]
  node_italic["Italic source"]

  node_fontc["fontc compiler"]

  node_italicfont["Italic variable font"]

node_designer(("Font author"))

node_designer -.->|"creates source"| node_roman
node_designer -.->|"creates source"| node_italic

node_italic -->|"compile with"| node_fontc

node_fontc -->|"produces"| node_italicfont

node_italicfont -->|"install and use"| node_fontuser

explication: Google Sans Code is a fixed-width font family for code, supplied as Roman and Italic variable fonts. Its documented workflow is to compile the Glyphs source packages with fontc into TTF variable fonts, then install and use those fonts in code editors or terminals. The README documents a weight axis from 300 to 800 and OpenType features including stylistic sets and localized forms. Source excerpts were not provided for the glyph packages, so their internal design structure and the exact compilation wiring are not shown.
